gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-neco: Nanum Gothic Coding writes like a relaxed hand, each letter bent from one length of tubing. And Neco, the text serif, swells gently from hairline to stem and feels dignified, though brief copy suits it best.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-fs-recia: Relaxed and personal, Playpen Sans draws every outline at a steady weight. What stands out is how Recia, a text serif, swells softly against that pressure-free line, and the pair is made for brief reading.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-fs-rowan: A broad, welcoming c gives Playpen Sans its hand-drawn friendliness. Rowan, a text serif whose thin strokes run about half its thick ones, fits brief copy, so give the heading plenty of size.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-outfit: A hand-drawn wave of friendliness, then tidy lines underneath. Playpen Sans supplies the personal, pen-drawn welcome while Outfit bends unshaded curves like cable, fine for brief reading.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-thai-sora: Loose, friendly handwriting on top, crisp geometric letters underneath. Playpen Sans Thai gives each stroke equal visual weight while Sora has no pressure swell either, a shared steadiness that suits brief reading.
gen-gf-potta-one-fs-rowan: Potta One draws a wire-like monoline skeleton with wide-set characters. It earns its keep big and short, while the serif Rowan adds slight but clear modulation and is comfortable for light reading.
gen-gf-ranga-fs-rowan: A dark, tightly knit stripe of text, cut from one ribbon. Ranga is best at a distinctive line or two, while Rowan, a serif with generous openings, carries steady reading.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-bhutuka-expanded: Expressive Snowburst One is a stencil sheet with wide bridges between letters, its lowercase built tall and its openings sprung wide. BhuTuka Expanded One, a text serif, slows the pace with stout, unclamped curves.
gen-gf-sofia-fs-rowan: Loose and hand-drawn, Sofia gives its crossbars the heft of its stems. And it earns its keep big and short, while Rowan, a serif with gentler stress, handles brief copy.
gen-gf-sofia-plus-jakarta-sans: Sofia is pure relaxed handwriting, friendly and unshaded in every curve it makes. And Plus Jakarta Sans keeps its monoline curve endings well apart, so a couple of lines beneath stay crisp.
